main_text.l: Sed cum eodem Apostolo inte pretamur ipsius ver-

mortali statu. Immediate enim hæc subdit --Neque
corruptio possidebit Incorruptionem. At ceteri, si
Christus in Cœlum ascenderit cum eodem corpore
quod e sepulchro resurrexit, & si resurrexit in
eodem Corpore quod in Sepulchro reconditum est,
(ut Evangelium diserte testatur) Corpus ipsius
jam in Cœlo glorificatum, habet eandem substanti-
am carnis & sanguinis, quam antea in Terris habu-
it, etsi qualitatibus mutatis. Idem enim qui se ex-
inaniv it usque ad mortem Crucis, à Deo fuit in Cœ-
los exaltatus, Phil. 2.7. 11. Christi Glorificatio
non peremit corpus ipsius, sed perfecit; neque aliquid
de eo abstulit, sed totum extulit. Alioquin Christus

page.notes: Running head "sana" and "recta" are doubtful, as is the first word of the note "Dignitas" (the initial D is worn). "Err." at the end of the first line is printed as it stands and may be a printing error. The first character of the marginal note "(Cor. 15. 50." is unclear and may be a numeral. The catchword "dextram" is printed in italics at the foot right. The text ends on "ad" because the catchword belongs to the next page.
